row.body: The old tool key is attached to a service slip that records a sprayer check after the tools were put away. No recipient signed the return.
row.title: Tools for someone else

sidecar.gloss: A tool check is recorded after the equipment was supposedly returned.
sidecar.rival_reading: Emergency workers could have checked shared equipment during cleanup; the missing signature does not identify the tool’s use.

row.body: the spool of thread and first-aid kit carry animal-feed grit under a strip of barrier tape. neither layer fully covers the other.
row.title: two traces on the spool of thread

sidecar.gloss: Farm residue and response markings share one deliberately ambiguous bundle.
sidecar.rival_reading: The farm program and the emergency response each explain one layer of the bundle, and the shared knot does not establish which purpose came first.
